messages:
Noah: uploaded a new mock — 'Cost + Tokens' compact row. Key idea: add a small per-token cost column next to token counts so finance can spot SKU regressions quickly. PTAL :eyes:
Priya: interesting. Quick question: does per-token cost live in org view too or only project scope?
Noah: plan is to show it everywhere but hide by default on org (shows as collapsed column). users can pin it per-table. saves vertical space.
Emma: accessibility nit: new column needs header with `aria-sort` if we let users sort by cost; also ensure numeric cells have role="cell" and readable labels like "$0.00012 per token" for SRs.
Tariq: UX concern: adding a column makes the compact table horizontal-scroll on mobile. Maybe collapse token units into a stacked micro-row when <420px to avoid scroll.
Priya: copy tweak: header text "Per-token cost" vs "Cost/token"? shorter string helps translations. locale-bot: prefer "Cost/token" as a single compact key.
Noah: ok we'll use "Cost/token". Hover tooltip will show full phrase and formula: `Total billed tokens / billed amount`.
ops-bot: a11y check: sort header missing keyboard activation, column doesn't announce change, table needs summary attribute for SRs.
Emma: also ensure numbers use locale formatting (commas, decimals) and provide data attribute with raw value for scripts.
Tariq: telemetry/experiment: add flag `billing.show_cost_column` and events `billing.pin_cost_column`, `billing.sort_by_cost`. Rollout 5% for 2 weeks to validate engagement and any perf impact.
Priya: invoice flow: leave Download button unchanged, but add small "Export CSV (with cost column)" option in the menu so finance can export enriched rows.
Noah: dev note: make the column lazy-rendered for large orgs to avoid initial render cost. we'll implement virtualization.
Emma: QA checklist: keyboard-only navigation for table, screen-reader readout for header + cell, mobile stacking at <420px, high-contrast colors for numeric text.
Noah: I'll update Figma with stacked-mobile frames, add ARIA annotations, and post a short diff. thanks all :raised_hands:
